name: refresh_weighted_state_table

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:07C2
name: tally_counts_and_roll_codes
description: Counts 8 table bytes into threshold counters by byte range, then draws a value from 1 to 100 for each of 20 entries and maps it to one of four codes. The codes are copied into a second 20-entry table through an index map.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:07F6
name: scan_bytes_then_roll_codes
description: Scans 8 table bytes in a loop, adding to threshold counters by byte range, then draws a value from 1 to 100 for each of 20 entries, maps it to a code and copies the codes into a second table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:07FC
name: tally_pass_then_roll_codes
description: Adds 5 to one threshold counter, scans 8 table bytes into the other counters by byte range, then draws values from 1 to 100 to fill 20 codes and copies them into a second table through an index map.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0802
name: scan_bytes_then_roll_again
description: Repeatedly adds 5 to a threshold counter and scans 8 table bytes by range, stopping once a byte falls outside the 59 to 71 band, then runs the same draw-to-code and copy steps as the surrounding routines.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0810
name: roll_codes_into_table
description: Draws a value from 1 to 100 for each of 20 entries, maps it to one of four codes using three threshold counters, and copies the 20 codes into a second table through an index map.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:082E
name: fill_table_in_code_runs
description: Fills a 20-entry table in runs: it draws values from 1 to 100 and repeats the current code while draws stay below the upper threshold, then picks the next code by comparing against the lower thresholds.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:083C
name: fill_table_in_threshold_runs
description: Fills a 20-entry table in runs of identical codes chosen from two counter thresholds, drawing values from 1 to 100 to decide when each run ends, and copies the finished codes into a second table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0848
name: fill_codes_with_draw_thresholds
description: Sets codes in a 20-entry table by comparing draws from 1 to 100 against threshold counters, starting from code 0 and switching codes when a draw crosses a threshold, then copies the codes through an index map.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0864
name: copy_codes_through_index_map
description: Copies 20 code bytes from one table into a second table, where each destination position is selected by an index byte read from a map.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:088C
name: emit_entries_or_uppercase_char
description: On one path it calls a helper 30 times with table-derived values for each entry. On the other path it stores two text pointers and a length, calls a helper, and returns the first character converted to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:08F2
name: clear_pairs_or_uppercase_char
description: On one path it walks four groups of flag pairs and clears one flag from each pair that is set, choosing which by a coin flip, and returns 18. On the other path it stores two text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0906
name: clear_random_flag_pairs
description: Walks four groups of flag pairs and clears one flag from each pair that is fully set, using a coin flip for which one, then runs a further pass over the remaining pairs at a stride of four.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:093C
name: scan_and_clear_flag_pairs
description: Scans the flag table for pairs whose flags are set and uses a coin flip to clear one flag per pair, repeating until no pair is left. A final stride-four pass clears more pairs the same way.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:094A
name: clear_flags_in_three_passes
description: Runs three passes over the flag table: a coin flip clears one flag from each set pair in the first group, a three-way random choice clears a flag from each fully set triple, and a final stride-four pass clears remaining set pairs by coin flip.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:097C
name: scan_and_clear_triple_flags
description: Scans for triples of set flags and clears one flag from each triple using a three-way random choice, repeating until none remain. It then runs a stride-four coin-flip pass over the flag pairs.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:098A
name: clear_triple_flags_then_pairs
description: Clears one flag from each fully set triple using a three-way random choice, then runs a stride-four pass that clears one flag from each set pair by coin flip.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:09C8
name: clear_triple_flags_with_pointer
description: Clears one flag from each fully set triple using a three-way random choice, writing the result through either a caller-supplied pointer or an internal one, then runs a stride-four coin-flip pass over the flag pairs.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:09D6
name: clear_one_of_triple_flags
description: Looks for a fully set triple of flags and clears one of its members chosen by a three-way random draw, repeating over the table. It then runs a stride-four coin-flip pass over pairs.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:09E4
name: clear_strided_flag_pairs
description: Walks 18 table positions in steps of four and, for each set pair of flags four positions apart, uses a coin flip to clear one of the two.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0A14
name: clear_one_of_strided_pairs
description: Walks 18 table positions in steps of four and, for each set pair of flags, uses a coin flip to clear either the first or the second flag of the pair.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0A26
name: render_record_entry_value
description: Looks up a 16-byte record by index and passes its text entry to helper routines. When a display flag is set, it counts the digits of a value up to 999 or more and places that number at a computed position; otherwise it stores two text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0B94
name: remap_record_slots_or_uppercase
description: Walks 10 records and, for each record whose slot byte is not the 255 sentinel, stores a byte from a lookup table into a field of that record, then returns 10. Otherwise it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0BA4
name: remap_ten_record_slots
description: For each of 10 records whose slot byte is not the 255 sentinel, stores a byte from a lookup table into a field of that record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0BE0
name: scan_slots_and_emit_result
description: Scans 8 table entries for one whose two bytes differ from the current record and whose target slot is empty, emits its text through helper calls and records the chosen value. A roll from 5 to 10 that comes up zero adds an extra separator and text before the result is stored and returned. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0C62
name: emit_result_from_entry_scan
description: Scans table entries from a given start position for one that differs from the current record and has an empty slot, emitting its text through helper calls. If a roll from 5 to 10 is zero it emits an extra separator and text, then stores the chosen value and the entry's two fields in the record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0CDA
name: scan_matching_entries_and_emit
description: Advances through record bytes while they match a stored value, then scans 8 table entries for one that differs from the current record and has an empty slot, emitting its text through helper calls. It finishes with the same roll from 5 to 10 and the same result storing as its sibling routines.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0D08
name: emit_text_and_store_result
description: Emits a separator when a flag is set and then the text for the current entry through helper calls, followed by a roll from 5 to 10 that can add a further text fragment. It then stores the chosen value and two fields in the record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0E3A
name: poll_helper_until_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls helper routines with a rotating index from 0 to 3 and a fixed value of 200, looping until a draw returns a nonzero result, which it returns. Otherwise it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0EAC
name: advance_slot_cursor_state
description: Advances a cursor over up to 10 slots, bumping a per-slot count and making coin-flip decisions, and resets all slot fields when the scan wraps. It returns 1 when a helper reports failure and 0 when a free slot is found; on the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0F10
name: advance_slot_cursor_with_reset
description: Copies a field forward through a slot and advances a cursor across 10 slots, skipping slots whose flags are both set and making coin-flip decisions at the wrap points. It returns 1 when a helper reports failure, and 0 once it reaches a slot whose flag is clear, saving that position as the cursor; when the scan fails it resets all slot fields.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0F40
name: advance_slot_cursor_from_start
description: Moves the cursor forward one slot, copying field values along the way, then scans 10 slots with coin-flip checks at the wrap points. It returns 1 on helper failure, otherwise saves the first slot with a clear flag as the cursor and returns 0; if the scan runs past the end it resets all slot fields.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0F60
name: clear_slot_fields_then_scan
description: Clears five state bytes in each of 10 slots, then scans for a slot with a clear flag using coin-flip checks at the wrap points. It returns 1 on helper failure, otherwise saves the found slot as the cursor and returns 0, and resets the slot fields when the scan passes the end.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0FAA
name: scan_slots_for_clear_flag
description: Scans 10 slots for one with a clear flag and saves it as the cursor, returning 0. When the scan passes the halfway point or the end, coin-flip checks decide whether field values are copied forward, and a second wrap resets all slot fields; it returns 1 when a helper reports failure.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0FD0
name: store_slot_cursor_index
description: Stores the supplied index into the slot cursor and returns 0, recording a position without any other work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:0FD8
name: walk_slots_for_free_entry
description: Walks 10 slots looking for one with a clear flag, with coin-flip checks and field copying at the halfway and wrap points. It saves the slot it finds as the cursor and returns 0, returns 1 on helper failure, and resets all slot fields when the scan wraps fully.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1004
name: advance_cursor_copy_then_scan
description: Copies a slot's field forward and advances through slots, returning 1 on helper failure and saving the first clear-flag slot as the cursor with a 0 return. Coin-flip checks and a copy of the upper slots decide whether to continue, and a full pass resets the slot fields.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1036
name: scan_slots_from_cursor_position
description: Starting from the current cursor, copies slot fields forward and scans for a slot with a clear flag, with coin-flip checks at the halfway and wrap points. It returns 1 on helper failure and 0 on finding a clear slot, and resets the slot fields when the scan wraps.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:104E
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use, so it performs no work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1054
name: reset_slot_table_if_full
description: Checks the first five slots and returns 0 as soon as it finds one with a clear flag. If all five are set, it marks slots one to four with the 255 sentinel, zeroes their counters, sets the first slot's counter to 20, and returns 1; on the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1062
name: check_five_slots_then_reset
description: Returns 0 when any of the first five slot flags is clear. Otherwise it marks slots one to four with the 255 sentinel, zeroes their counters, sets the first slot's counter to 20, and returns 1.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:107A
name: check_slots_then_reset_all
description: Scans slots one to four for a clear flag and returns 0 if it finds one. When all four are set, it marks them with the 255 sentinel, zeroes their counters, sets the first counter to 20, and returns 1.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1086
name: reset_five_slot_table
description: Marks the first five slots with the 255 sentinel and zeroes their counters, then sets the first slot's byte to zero and its counter to 20, and returns 1.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:10BE
name: clear_marked_flags_or_uppercase
description: Walks 10 slots and clears a flag byte in each slot whose id byte is 17, then returns 10. On the other path it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:10CC
name: clear_marked_slot_flags
description: Walks 10 slots and clears a flag byte in each slot whose id byte is 17.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:10F6
name: check_cursor_slot_available
description: Returns 0 when the cursor slot's second flag is set, returns 1 when its count byte is zero, and otherwise returns 1 only if the count is below a limit taken from a lookup table keyed by the slot's id byte. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:111E
name: check_slot_count_below_limit
description: Returns 1 when a slot's count byte is zero or below a limit taken from a lookup table indexed by the slot's id byte, and 0 otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1128
name: compare_slot_count_to_limit
description: Returns whether a slot's count byte is below the limit read from a lookup table indexed by its id byte.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1146
name: match_or_claim_slot_entry
description: Compares a byte from an 8-byte table with the current slot's stored value and its neighbour. If they differ it searches the 10 slots for a match, checking the first five with a helper, and if none matches it stores the new value in the current slot and calls a helper with the old value. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:11D2
name: find_value_or_replace_slot
description: Searches 10 slots for one holding a given byte. If it is found among the first five and a helper check passes, it calls a helper with the index; if none holds the byte, it overwrites a slot chosen by the caller and calls a helper with the old value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:11F4
name: search_slots_from_second_slot
description: Searches slots from the second onward for one holding a given byte. If it is found among the first five and a helper check passes, it calls a helper with the index; if none holds the byte, it overwrites a caller-chosen slot and calls a helper with the old value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1214
name: pass_one_to_helper
description: Passes the constant 1 to a helper routine and returns without further work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:121E
name: forward_two_stack_bytes
description: Forwards two byte arguments from its stack frame to a helper routine and returns.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1234
name: check_slot_and_store_result
description: Calls a helper with the slot's id byte and its stored word, saves the returned flag in a state byte, then either passes 1 to a helper when the flag is zero or passes the slot index with zeros to a helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1274
name: advance_slot_count_and_report
description: Emits one of two text entries through helpers according to a state flag, clears that flag, bumps the cursor slot's count from a lookup table, and reports the cursor position through helpers. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1294
name: report_slot_after_count_bump
description: Emits a fixed text entry through a helper, clears the state flag, bumps the cursor slot's count from a lookup table, and reports the cursor position through helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:12EE
name: bump_state_and_mark_cursor
description: Increments a per-cursor state byte and, when a second state byte is zero, copies the cursor slot's field forward and marks its flag with 255, then returns the result of a helper. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1330
name: report_or_decrement_cursor_slot
description: If the cursor slot's lookup value is zero, it passes a position and fixed values to a helper and returns that helper's result. Otherwise it signals a helper, decrements the cursor slot's counter byte and returns the cursor index. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1376
name: report_fixed_coordinates_pair
description: Passes two table-derived values together with the fixed numbers 11 and 12 to a helper, then passes zero to another helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:139C
name: report_slot_or_decrement_count
description: On a zero roll from 5 to 10, if the cursor slot's id byte falls in certain ranges and a byte beside it is set, it reports fixed coordinates through a helper and returns 1. Otherwise it passes 2 to a helper, decrements the cursor slot's counter and returns the cursor index. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:140C
name: branch_report_or_decrement
description: If a flag byte passed in is zero, it passes 2 to a helper and decrements the cursor slot's counter. Otherwise it reports the fixed coordinates 11 and 12 through a helper and passes 1 to another helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:143C
name: confirm_then_reset_slots
description: Displays three fixed-position lines through helpers, then waits for a key: Y marks five slots with the 255 sentinel, while N or escape skips that step. It finishes with a helper call and returns its result. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1462
name: show_prompt_and_reset_slots
description: Shows three fixed-position lines through helpers, then waits for a Y or N key or escape, and on Y marks five slots with the 255 sentinel. It then calls a helper with a fixed buffer and the value 2.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:14DA
name: reset_five_slot_markers
description: Marks the first five slots by setting three of their bytes to the 255 sentinel, then calls a helper and a second helper with a fixed buffer and the value 2.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1522
name: pass_cursor_entry_pointer
description: Passes fixed zero and one values to helpers, then passes the table entry selected by the cursor slot's id byte to another helper and returns its result. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:156A
name: pass_secondary_entry_pointer
description: Passes one to a helper, then passes the table entry selected by the secondary cursor's slot id byte to another helper and returns its result. On the other path it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:15A6
name: pass_cursor_entry_and_report
description: Passes one to a helper, then passes the table entry selected by the cursor slot's id byte and a fixed pointer to further helpers, and returns the result of a last helper. On the other path it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:15EE
name: chain_helper_results
description: Passes the result of one helper call into a second helper and returns that result. On the other path it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:160C
name: handle_grid_cursor_command
description: Processes one command code from a key-driven loop. name: run_grid_key_loop
description: Repeatedly reads a key through helpers and updates the cursor on a grid of slots, with keypad-style codes moving it and select codes checking, emitting text and marking the slot. An escape code ends the loop, and when a flag is clear it emits closing text through helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1686
name: run_cursor_key_loop
description: Runs a key-driven loop over a 6-column slot grid: command codes move the cursor by keypad-style offsets, select codes check slot entries through helpers and emit text, and an escape code decrements the cursor slot's counter. Each cursor move emits the old and new slot text through helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:16F6
name: step_cursor_and_read_key
description: Moves the cursor back one slot unless its id byte is 15, emits the old and new slot entries through helpers when it has moved, then reads the next key and dispatches it through the same command handling as its sibling routines.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:170A
name: advance_cursor_read_key
description: Advances the cursor one slot unless its id byte is -1, emits the old and new slot entries through helpers when it has moved, then reads the next key and dispatches it through the same command handling as its sibling routines.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1724
name: wrap_cursor_row_read_key
description: Moves the cursor back a row of six when it lies past the sixth slot, emits the old and new slot entries through helpers when it has moved, then reads the next key and dispatches it through the same command handling as its siblings.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1732
name: advance_cursor_row_key_loop
description: Runs the key-driven grid loop with a cursor step that moves down one row of six slots when the target stays within the 30-slot grid. Each move emits the old and new slot entries through helpers, and select codes check or mark slots through helpers as in its sibling routines.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1744
name: run_grid_loop_up_left
description: Runs the key-driven grid loop starting with an up-left step: the cursor moves back seven positions only when its id byte is not 15 and the byte beside it is not 22. name: run_grid_loop_up_right
description: Runs the key-driven grid loop starting with an up-right step: the cursor moves back five positions only when its id byte is not -1 and the byte beside it is not 22. It emits the old and new slot entries through helpers and dispatches later keys through the shared command handling, where an escape code decrements the cursor slot's counter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:178E
name: run_grid_loop_down_left
description: Runs the key-driven grid loop starting with a down-left step: the cursor moves forward five positions only when its id byte is not 15 and the byte beside it is not -98. It emits the old and new slot entries through helpers and dispatches later keys through the shared command handling, where an escape code decrements the cursor slot's counter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:17B6
name: run_grid_loop_down_right
description: Runs the key-driven grid loop starting with a down-right step: the cursor moves forward seven positions only when its id byte is not -1 and the byte beside it is not -98. It emits the old and new slot entries through helpers and dispatches later keys through the shared command handling, where an escape code decrements the cursor slot's counter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:17E4
name: grid_dispatch_from_command_zero
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the mode-zero handler, which checks the cursor slot through a helper and, when it passes, records the cursor as the secondary cursor and bumps that slot's counter. It then falls through the remaining handlers and the shared key loop.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:182E
name: grid_dispatch_from_command_two
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the mode-two handler, which checks the cursor slot against a range of 5 through a helper and, on success, sets the mode flags. It then falls through the remaining handlers and the shared key loop.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1860
name: grid_dispatch_three_or_four
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the handler for modes three and four, which checks the cursor slot against a range of 10 through a helper and, on success, emits the slot text and sets flags. It then falls through the remaining handlers and the shared key loop.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:18CC
name: grid_dispatch_from_command_five
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the mode-five handler, which checks the cursor slot through a helper and, on success, compares two stored counts of the secondary slot. key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:191C
name: reset_secondary_cursor_then_loop
description: Marks the secondary cursor with the 255 sentinel, then runs the shared key loop with its cursor steps and handlers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1926
name: grid_dispatch_from_command_six
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the mode-six handler, which checks the cursor slot through a helper and, when its id byte is 4 and the byte beside it is not 23, emits slot text and sets flags. Otherwise it marks the secondary cursor with the 255 sentinel, then falls through the remaining handlers and the shared key loop.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:19B6
name: reset_secondary_cursor_entry
description: Marks the secondary cursor with the 255 sentinel and enters the shared key loop from its top.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:19C0
name: grid_dispatch_from_command_one
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the mode-one handler: when a helper check with a range of 4 passes, it emits the cursor slot's text, updates the slot's count from a lookup table, and sets flags. It then falls through the remaining handlers and the shared key loop.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1A5E
name: grid_dispatch_from_escape_code
description: Enters the grid command dispatch at the escape handler, which decrements the cursor slot's counter. It then falls through the remaining handlers and the shared key loop, whose cursor steps and select handling make up the rest of the routine.

name: clear_slot_displays_or_uppercase
description: On the main path it calls a helper to start a display update, passes the index and zero to a helper for each of the 10 slots, and returns the result of a final helper. On the other path it stores text pointers, calls a helper and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1BDE

name: forward_with_code_ten

description: Saves the state byte of the current slot, writes the parameter into it, calls helpers that report the slot's stored fields, and returns the result of a final helper. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1C32
name: iterate_records_until_empty
description: Repeatedly fetches a record through a helper until none remains, passing each record to another helper and, when its flag bit 1024 is set, to a third helper with its field. It returns 0 at the end. On the other path it stores text pointers and returns the first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1C38
name: emit_fixed_codes_by_mode
description: When its first parameter is 0, it emits a fixed series of helper calls with constant codes, choosing extra codes according to its second and third parameters. name: emit_ten_row_entries

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1C44

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1C56

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1C5C
name: forward_with_code_nine

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1C74

name: store_two_table_handles

name: show_indexed_entry_then_return

name: store_parameter_and_notify_pair

name: pass_result_through_two_helpers

name: run_helper_chain_with_sixteen

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr csl][a3]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr CSL][a3].adf:King's Bounty:2:1CF2
